title: Fundamentals
shortDescription: Master the building blocks: variables, loops, control flow, functions, and memory basics.
about: Before tackling complex algorithms, you must build a flawless foundation. This level guides you through basic programming constructs, primitive types, memory allocations, and scoping, preparing your mind for computational thinking.
whatYouWillLearn: Memory structure: Stack vs Heap basics
Basic space and time analysis concepts

title: Beginner DSA
shortDescription: Master mathematical foundations, arrays, strings, basic recursion, sorting, searching, and bit manipulation.
about: Step into the core methodologies of computational problem solving. Learn mathematical bases, array manipulation, search boundaries, basic divide-and-conquer, and hardware-level bit trickery.

title: Intermediate DSA Level 1
shortDescription: Master core intermediate data structures and algorithms: Hashing, Prefix Sum, Sliding Window, Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues, Trees, and Heaps.
about: Take your programming skills to the next level by mastering foundational data structures and patterns. This level takes you through efficient lookup maps, window traversal strategies, dynamic linear nodes, priority structures, and hierarchical trees.
whatYouWillLearn: Hashing map queries & prefix sum arrays
Stacks, Queues, Binary Search Trees, and Heaps

title: Intermediate DSA Level 2
shortDescription: Master Greedy Choice, Dynamic Programming (DP), and Graph Algorithms (BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, Floyd-Warshall).
about: Explore optimizing complex problems using greedy paradigms, state transition models, and graph traversals. Master subset-sum logic, path transitions, cycle detection, shortest paths, and articulation points.
whatYouWillLearn: Shortest paths, minimum spanning trees, and disjoint sets

title: Advanced DSA
shortDescription: Conquer advanced graphs, network flow models, bipartite matching, and heuristic search algorithms.
about: Model interconnected systems with constraints. Learn pathfinding algorithms used by maps and routers, and explore the power of subproblem memoization to solve complex recursive optimizations.

title: DSA Masters Level 1
shortDescription: Master advanced recursion, backtracking, and complex Dynamic Programming patterns.
about: Step into elite problem solving by mastering decision state generation and pruning. This level covers topological sorting, disjoint set union, and advanced optimization paradigms.
whatYouWillLearn: Knapsack, LCS, and Matrix Chain DP patterns

title: DSA Masters Level 2
shortDescription: Advanced string algorithms, Trie data structures, and segment trees.
about: Implement query-efficient indexing for large-scale string and range data. Learn how search engines autocompleting queries and database range queries are optimized behind the scenes.
whatYouWillLearn: Trie structures for dictionary indexing & routing
Segment Trees & Fenwick Trees (Binary Indexed Trees)

title: DSA Masters Level 3
shortDescription: Advanced graph topologies, network flow, and heuristic search algorithms.
about: Push boundaries with network flow models, bipartite matching, and heuristics. Understand complex structural connectivity and flow bottlenecks.

title: DSA DEMI GOD
shortDescription: The absolute peak. Approximate algorithms, randomized data structures, and cache-oblivious designs.
about: Achieve the status of a Demi God. Solve NP-hard approximations, learn randomized structures like Skip Lists, Bloom Filters, and implement cache-friendly designs optimized for physical hardware architecture.
whatYouWillLearn: Randomized algorithms, Bloom filters, and Skip Lists
Advanced bit manipulation and hardware-level trickery
